contents.title: Quiz Diagnostic 1ere Anglais - Serie 23
contents.subject: Anglais
contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : La voix passive – tous les temps

questions.question: Which sentence is correctly written in the passive voice (present simple)?
choices: The cake is make by my mother every Sunday.
The cake is made by my mother every Sunday.
The cake made by my mother every Sunday.
The cake is been made by my mother every Sunday.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The letter was written by John', the passive voice is in the past simple tense.
Transforme la phrase suivante à la voix passive : 'They will build a new hospital next year.'
Choose the correct passive form for the present perfect: 'Someone has stolen my bike.'
In a passive sentence, the agent introduced by 'by' is always mandatory.
Transforme la phrase suivante à la voix passive : 'The company is launching a new product.'
Which sentence uses the passive voice in the past continuous?
choices: The road was repaired last week.
The road is being repaired now.
The road was being repaired when the accident happened.
The road has been repaired recently.

questions.question: The sentence 'English is spoken all over the world' uses the present simple passive correctly.

exercisenotion.description: La voix passive se forme avec l'auxiliaire 'be' conjugué au temps voulu + le participe passé du verbe. Ex : The letter is written / was written / has been written.
Chaque temps actif a son équivalent passif : present simple → is/are + V3, past simple → was/were + V3, present perfect → has/have been + V3, future → will be + V3, etc.
L'agent (celui qui fait l'action) est introduit par 'by'. Il peut être omis s'il est inconnu, évident ou sans importance. Ex : 'The window was broken (by someone).'
